reasoning:
1. Scope (POL-GEN-08(1)): NO_SHOW_CHARGE, no safety/complaint flag; automated ruling may issue. Filed by DRIVER for SGD 4.50 after support refunded the rider's cancellation fee (EV-TRIP-04052 fee_refunded 2026-09-23 10:15; EV-FARE-04052 payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 4.50). Route-deviation clauses (POL-RD-01..13, POL-RD-14 amendment) do not apply to this category.
2. Fee schedule: trip_record carries platform_policy (free_wait_sec 180, grace_after_match_sec 180, cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50 net, gross 6.61, arrival_marker BUTTON, zone STANDARD). Fare line 4.50 equals the net figure, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.
3. Who terminated: the trip was CANCELLED_BY_RIDER (reason RIDER_CANCELLED), not driver-terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-01 limb (d) is not met literally; the rider's own cancellation is decided under POL-NS-10, which is the clause written for it.
4. POL-NS-10(a): cancellation 19:35:30 is 690 s after accepted_at 19:24:00 > 180 s grace; not within grace. (b) not scheduled (scheduled_at null). (d)/(e) no waiting-time line (waiting_time_fee 0.00).
5. POL-NS-02 arrival: pickup pin 1.3744,103.8861. Haversine (R=6371.0088 km): fixes 19:30:50 16.0 m, 19:31:00 7.7 m, 19:31:10 7.3 m and all fixes to 19:35:30 between 1.2 and 16.0 m, accuracy 3.6-8.9 m (all <= 25 m) - at least 3 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. Arrived.
6. POL-NS-01(c) dwell (measured from first qualifying in-geofence fix, not the button): 19:30:50 -> 19:35:30 = 280 s continuous (stationary 0 km/h from 19:31:00, = 270 s), > free_wait_sec 180 s. no_show_threshold_sec null.
7. POL-NS-10(g): rider cancelled after arrival under POL-NS-02 with in-geofence dwell already exceeding free_wait_sec -> the fee stands at platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50 as if driver-terminated for no-show; limb (f) exceptions do not apply. (For completeness they would fail anyway: driver en route 19:24:10 within grace; ETA 7 min shown at 19:24:00 -> 19:31:00 and arrival 19:31:00 is within 180 s of it; no request to cancel in chat; no vehicle/driver mismatch on record.)
8. Displacing clauses: POL-NS-03 no (driver stationary inside 50 m, not 50-400 m out). POL-NS-04 no: the rider's only locating/coordinating message 'how long more?' (MSG-04052-002, 19:28:30) was answered by the driver in 20 s (MSG-04052-003, 19:28:50), failing limb (b); limb (c) also fails affirmatively - rider_track 288.9-303.4 m from the pin from 19:31:00 on (> 100 m STANDARD presence radius), accuracy 5.1-11.6 m. POL-NS-05 no: arrival marker 19:31:00 coincides with a fix at 7.7 m, 0 km/h (not >300 m, not >=15 km/h). POL-NS-06 no: dwell 280 s >= 180 s. POL-NS-11 not engaged (rider_track present and decidable). POL-NS-12 not engaged (arrival_marker BUTTON).
9. Integrity: POL-NS-08(a) arrival event matches a fix at 0 s offset; (b) no gaps, max interval 10 s, 28 fixes in window, rider_track present; (c) 5 sequential messages = chat_message_count 5, largest gap 260 s < 5 min; (d) fare reconciles. No policy-level impairment. EV-ADVIS-04052-01 is IMPAIRED (weight 0.5, ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED) but carries no deciding fact (it would only matter for POL-NS-06(i) summing, which is not needed, and CONGESTION is not a listed type there), so per POL-GEN-02 it does not cap confidence. Deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-04052 and EV-GPS-04052, both weight 1.0 -> cap 1.0, above the 0.70 floor.
10. POL-NS-09: (a) confidence high; (b) no contradiction between artifacts - rider's statement that she walked to the main road and cancelled matches rider_track; driver's 'waited more than 4 min' matches 270-280 s; (c) disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0+0; (d) anti-farming not tripped, rider no_show_disputes_30d 0; (e) no sole impaired evidence. No escalation.
11. POL-NS-07 payout: anti-farming check no_show_terminations_30d 0 (<4; 0/143 = 0 <= 0.08) -> compensation paid at 80% of the NET fee: 4.50 x 0.80 = 3.60 (never on gross 6.61). Ruling value DRIVER_COMPENSATION; per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd = 3.60. The filing driver asked for 4.50; the 20% residual (0.90) is the platform service fee under POL-NS-07, so the full 4.50 is not owed to him.
12. POL-GEN-01: profile fields other than the citable counters (ratings 4.64/4.88, cancellation_rate, prior_disputes, lifetime trips) were not used. POL-GEN-05: monetary effect 3.60 <= execution_threshold_sgd 8.00 -> auto-executes, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. No referrals arise (no false marker, no mis-selected reason code).
doubts: (1) Support has already refunded the rider SGD 4.50. POL-NS-10(g) says the fee 'stands', but POL-GEN-03 says NO_ACTION never means 'restore the charge' and the policy does not say whether DRIVER_COMPENSATION reverses the support refund; the ruling as emitted (driver paid 3.60) is unaffected, but the rider-side execution (re-charge vs platform absorbs) is not settled by the text. (2) Amount: the driver contested 4.50 ('give me back my cancellation fee'); a reader treating the driver as the 'filing party entitled to the whole contested amount' might put 4.50, but POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80% of the net fee = 3.60. (3) A reader treating POL-NS-01 limb (d) literally (no driver termination with RIDER_NO_SHOW) without reaching POL-NS-10(g) might rule NO_ACTION leaving the rider refunded; POL-NS-10(g) expressly covers this rider-cancel-after-dwell fact pattern, so I reject that. (4) Dwell start: 19:30:50 (first in-radius fix, moving at 5 km/h) vs 19:31:00 (first stationary fix) gives 280 s vs 270 s; both exceed 180 s, so the outcome does not turn on it.
